en: Changed `claude ultrareview` to require workspace trust: it asks on a terminal, else refuses; scripts pass `--trust-workspace`, which takes no value (put a PR number or base branch before it), or set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1`
zh: 变更 `claude ultrareview`：现在要求工作区信任，在终端上会询问，否则拒绝；脚本可传入 `--trust-workspace`（该参数不取值，PR 编号或基础分支需放在它前面），或设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK=1`
